declaration.preface: At Plastipak Packaging Inc. (Group), we are committed to maintaining exemplary standards of labor and human rights throughout our global operations. This Labor and Human Rights Policy highlights our dedication to fair labor practices, the respect for human dignity, and the promotion of diversity and inclusion. We strive to cultivate a workplace that is safe, respectful, and equitable for all employees and stakeholders, while ensuring compliance with relevant laws and international human rights principles.
declaration.declaration:
Fair Employment Practices: We are dedicated to treating all employees with fairness and respect, ensuring their rights to freely choose their employment, receive fair compensation, and work in safe conditions. We firmly prohibit forced labor, child labor, and all forms of discrimination.

Diversity and Inclusion: We aim to create a diverse workforce and nurture an inclusive workplace culture that appreciates and respects individuals from varied backgrounds. Our goal is to eliminate biases in hiring, promotions, and development opportunities, ensuring that all employees have equal access to advancement.

Employee Health and Safety: We prioritize the health, safety, and well-being of our workforce by implementing thorough health and safety initiatives, providing access to mental health support, and promoting a healthy work-life balance. Our aim is to foster an environment where employees feel safe, supported, and empowered to express their concerns.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all Plastipak employees, contractors, third-party partners, and internal and external stakeholders, including customers directly or indirectly associated with Plastipak. It encompasses all offices, headquarters, facilities, and operational sites where Plastipak provides packaging solutions, recycled materials, and transportation services. This policy ensures that respect for labor rights, human rights, and fair working conditions are integral to our operations worldwide, promoting ethical practices across the organization.

Employee Well-being and Safety: We are committed to prioritizing the health and safety of our workforce by implementing comprehensive programs that promote a safe and healthy work environment.
Our focus includes establishing rigorous safety protocols and conducting regular training sessions to enhance employee awareness.
We provide access to essential health resources to prevent workplace injuries and illnesses.
Our objective is to foster a culture of safety where every employee feels empowered to raise concerns and contribute to safety initiatives.

We aim to strengthen workplace safety by adopting the Human and Organizational Performance (HOP) approach, focusing on improving systems, behaviors, and processes to reduce risks and enhance employee well-being across all operations.
We aim to create a proactive health and safety culture by conducting regular training sessions and workshops that empower employees with knowledge and skills.
Our goal is to maintain a zero-accident workplace by implementing strict safety protocols and conducting frequent safety audits across all facilities.
We strive to enhance mental health support services, ensuring all employees have access to resources that promote psychological well-being and resilience.
Regular health assessments will be conducted to identify and address potential risks, ensuring a safe working environment for everyone involved.
Workplace Environment: We are dedicated to creating positive and equitable working conditions that enable all employees to thrive.
This involves ensuring proper ergonomics and providing access to necessary resources for all staff.
We maintain open lines of communication to effectively address workplace issues as they arise.
Regular assessments and enhancements to our facilities will improve the overall employee experience and promote productivity.
We are committed to fostering an inclusive and positive work environment that emphasizes respect, support, work-life balance, and the right to disconnect.
We aim to provide a comprehensive benefits package that helps our associates and their families be well—physically, mentally and financially.
Clean and well-organized workspaces are a priority, with plans to uphold high standards of hygiene while offering fair compensation and comprehensive social benefits.
To eliminate workplace harassment and discrimination, we will introduce initiatives promoting inclusivity and conduct regular employee satisfaction surveys to address concerns.
Mutual respect will be nurtured through team-building activities, open communication channels, and programs focused on employee well-being and maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
Our approach includes the continuous evaluation and improvement of workplace practices, ensuring fair pay, social benefits, and the right to disconnect for a safe and productive environment.
Prohibition of Child Labor, Forced Labor: We categorically reject child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking in all forms within our operations and supply chain.
Our policy mandates strict adherence to local and international labor laws to uphold human rights standards.
We implement proactive measures to prevent violations and ensure ethical practices within our supply chain.
Conducting thorough audits of our suppliers allows us to ensure alignment with our commitment to ethical labor practices.
We are dedicated to ensuring that our operations are free from child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking through rigorous supplier assessments and audits.
Our objective is to implement a comprehensive reporting mechanism that allows employees and stakeholders to report any suspected violations confidentially.
We strive to educate our suppliers on ethical labor practices, ensuring they understand our zero-tolerance policy towards exploitation in all forms.
Ongoing partnerships with NGOs will enhance our capability to identify and address potential human rights violations within our supply chain.
Labor Relations: We strive to cultivate positive labor relations through constructive dialogue between management and employees.
Our commitment includes respecting workers' rights to freely associate and engage in collective bargaining without interference.
We prioritize transparent communication and actively collaborate with labor representatives to resolve issues.
This approach enables us to effectively address concerns and enhance workplace relations.
We aim to foster a collaborative labor environment by facilitating open dialogue between management and employees, ensuring all voices are heard and respected.
Our goal is to resolve disputes promptly and effectively, maintaining a harmonious workplace and positive relationships with labor representatives.
We strive to provide training for managers on effective communication and conflict resolution strategies to strengthen labor relations across all levels.
Regular engagement surveys will be conducted to gauge employee satisfaction and identify areas for improvement in labor relations practices.
Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion: We are devoted to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where every individual is treated fairly and with respect.
Our initiatives actively promote equal opportunities for all employees, regardless of their background.
We engage in diversity training and awareness campaigns to support our objectives for inclusivity.
Targeted recruitment efforts help us create a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve.

As an active corporate member of the Women in Manufacturing (WiM) Association, we provide our female associates worldwide access to the organization’s networking events, fostering professional growth and leadership development.
We are dedicated to cultivating a diverse and inclusive culture where every employee feels welcomed, respected, and valued.
Our commitment includes ongoing reviews and improvements to address disparities and better support diverse and underrepresented groups across the organization.
We aim to provide comprehensive training to promote awareness, respect for different perspectives, and a collaborative, inclusive work environment.
Establishing measurable goals will help us ensure continuous progress and demonstrate our strong dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Embedding DEI principles into all areas of operation is essential to fostering an equitable and culturally rich environment for everyone.
Human Rights in External Stakeholder Eng: We acknowledge the importance of respecting human rights within our organization and among external stakeholders.
Our policy ensures that suppliers and partners uphold the same human rights standards that we maintain.
We aim to conduct due diligence to assess and mitigate human rights risks throughout our supply chain.
This commitment promotes responsible business practices across all levels of engagement with external parties.
We strive to respect and promote human rights in all interactions with external stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability in our operations.
Our objective is to conduct regular human rights assessments to identify potential impacts and engage with affected communities proactively.
We aim to develop partnerships with local organizations to support human rights initiatives and contribute positively to community well-being.
Regular training will be provided for employees on human rights issues, ensuring awareness and adherence to best practices in stakeholder interactions.
Career Management and Development: We are focused on supporting our employees' career management by providing robust opportunities for growth and development.
Access to training programs and mentorship initiatives are essential components of our policy.
We aim to establish clear pathways for advancement within the organization to encourage employee progression.
By nurturing talent, we strive to foster an environment where employees can achieve their professional goals and contribute to our collective success.
We are committed to providing robust career development opportunities, ensuring all employees have access to resources that support their growth and advancement.
Our goal is to implement mentorship programs that connect employees with leaders within the organization, fostering personal and professional development.
We strive to offer regular training sessions focused on skill enhancement and career progression to empower employees in their career paths.
Annual performance reviews will be utilized to identify development needs and create individualized career plans that align with employee aspirations and organizational goals.

policy.monitoring:
We will compile annual reports detailing our performance in labor and human rights, tracking progress against key metrics such as employee well-being, diversity, and workplace safety.

These reports will be disseminated to stakeholders—including employees, clients, suppliers, and investors—to uphold transparency and accountability.

Regular internal audits will be conducted to ensure adherence to labor laws, company policies, and operational objectives.

Findings from these audits will be reviewed by senior management, and corrective actions will be promptly taken to rectify any identified shortcomings.

We will actively involve stakeholders through surveys, consultations, and meetings to collect their insights on our labor practices and identify potential areas for enhancement.

Partnering with stakeholders will help us stay aligned with current labor trends and industry standards.

A dedicated platform will be established to enable employees, clients, and external parties to confidentially report labor-related concerns without fear of retaliation.

All grievances will be investigated thoroughly, and appropriate measures will be taken to address the issues raised.

We will publicly share essential labor metrics, achievements, and challenges on an annual basis through sustainability reports or designated sections on our website.

This commitment to transparency underscores our dedication to labor rights and accountability to all stakeholders.

Governance of this policy ensures accountability at all levels, with the Board of Directors providing strategic oversight and establishing labor goals. Senior leadership integrates labor rights into operations and monitors performance, while the Labor Compliance Officer ensures regulatory compliance and reports progress. Department heads implement practices within their areas, driving workplace safety and employee engagement. Employees and contractors actively contribute to labor initiatives and report on improvements. Suppliers and partners collaborate to meet labor targets and uphold ethical practices. Regular audits, stakeholder engagement, and transparent reporting will facilitate continuous improvement and alignment with evolving labor standards.

We are dedicated to continually improving our labor practices by establishing measurable goals, tracking progress, and identifying areas for enhancement. Regular internal audits, performance evaluations, and stakeholder feedback will help ensure our practices remain effective and in line with emerging labor standards. Additionally, we will benchmark against industry best practices to drive innovation and strengthen our labor initiatives.

This policy will be reviewed annually to adapt to changing regulations, technological advancements, and labor trends. Training programs and awareness initiatives will foster a culture of respect for labor rights among employees, empowering them to contribute to our labor objectives. Through collaboration with partners and suppliers, we aim to develop new solutions that enhance workplace fairness, promote safety, and uphold human rights throughout our value chain.
policy.reviewMechanism: HR Head will perform an annual review of this policy to evaluate its effectiveness and relevance. This process will include assessing compliance with labor regulations, analysing performance metrics, and identifying improvement opportunities. Recommendations will be documented and presented to management for consideration and action.
